title: StockX Product Scraper Input
description: Configure scraping parameters. Start with 10-100 products for testing.

startUrls.title: 🔗 Product URLs or Search Pages
startUrls.description: Add product URLs, category pages, or search results. Supports batch scraping.

maxResults.title: Maximum products
maxResults.description: Stop after scraping this many products. Start with 100 for testing. ⚠️ Higher values increase time and cost.

extractPricing.title: Extract real-time pricing data
extractPricing.description: Enable to scrape bid/ask prices and last sale. ⚠️ Requires JavaScript rendering, increases runtime by 3-5x.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies strongly recommended for avoiding blocks. Datacenter proxies have 60%+ failure rate.

debugMode.title: Debug mode
debugMode.description: Enable verbose logging. Only use for troubleshooting.
